NEOW.talk.SATORI.0-0.ancient: Another soul hoping to take something from the Tower. Who are you looking for?
NEOW.talk.SATORI.0-1.char: My little sister, Koishi Komeiji. She closed her Third Eye and hid even her thoughts in her unconscious.
NEOW.talk.SATORI.0-2.ancient: You can hear everyone's wishes, yet hers elude you.
NEOW.talk.SATORI.0-3.char: So this time, I'll have to find her myself.
NEOW.talk.SATORI.1-0.ancient: You're back. Did you hear her voice in the Tower?
NEOW.talk.SATORI.1-1.char: No. But someone remembers a girl in a green hat. I'll follow those memories.
NEOW.talk.SATORI.2-0r.ancient: Are you still looking for your sister this time?
NEOW.talk.SATORI.2-1r.char: Yes. When I find her, I'll first ask if she wants to come home.
DARV.talk.SATORI.0-0.ancient: Your eyes are fixed on the distance, but your feet remain here.
DARV.talk.SATORI.0-1.char: I'm chasing someone who leaves no thoughts behind. Have you seen Koishi Komeiji?
DARV.talk.SATORI.0-2.ancient: A road leaves footprints. A stone cannot read them for you.
DARV.talk.SATORI.0-3.char: Then lend me a little strength. I'll walk the rest myself.
DARV.talk.SATORI.1-0.ancient: You haven't brought her back yet?
DARV.talk.SATORI.1-1.char: She's freer than I imagined—and harder to find.
DARV.talk.SATORI.2-0r.ancient: Don't only listen. Watch your step.
DARV.talk.SATORI.2-1r.char: I'll remember. Perhaps she's in one of those quiet places.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SATORI.0-0.ancient: Looking for someone? A name, a face, or a good price?
NONUPEIPE.talk.SATORI.0-1.char: A green hat, a closed Third Eye. You don't have her face in mind.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SATORI.0-2.ancient: You make a rather uncomfortable deal.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SATORI.0-3.char: Don't worry. I buy clues, not lies.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SATORI.1-0.ancient: What if I told you I had a clue about her?
NONUPEIPE.talk.SATORI.1-1.char: You're thinking about last time's price. Show me a real clue first.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SATORI.2-0r.ancient: What are you buying this time?
NONUPEIPE.talk.SATORI.2-1r.char: Something to carry me farther. I'll find the rest myself.
OROBAS.talk.SATORI.0-0.ancient: Your eyes have already seen too much. Still want to see farther?
OROBAS.talk.SATORI.0-1.char: Seeing farther won't help. Koishi closed more than that eye.
OROBAS.talk.SATORI.0-2.ancient: Then turn the thoughts you hear into strength. The road lies ahead.
OROBAS.talk.SATORI.0-3.char: I will. But when I find her, I'll wait for her to speak for herself.
OROBAS.talk.SATORI.1-0.ancient: You're still searching for that silent heart.
OROBAS.talk.SATORI.1-1.char: Yes. I want to know where she went. I won't force her to open her eye again.
OROBAS.talk.SATORI.2-0r.ancient: Reach out. You still need my touch.
OROBAS.talk.SATORI.2-1r.char: This time, help me hold on to even the smallest clues.
PAEL.talk.SATORI.0-0.ancient: Do you miss your sister—or the sister you used to know?
PAEL.talk.SATORI.0-1.char: ...That thought cuts deeper than it would aloud.
PAEL.talk.SATORI.0-2.ancient: An empty place can imprison many memories.
PAEL.talk.SATORI.0-3.char: She isn't a memory. I'll find who she is now.
PAEL.talk.SATORI.1-0.ancient: What if she doesn't want to come back?
PAEL.talk.SATORI.1-1.char: Then at least let me hear her say it herself—even without that eye.
PAEL.talk.SATORI.2-0r.ancient: Are you ready to face the answer?
PAEL.talk.SATORI.2-1r.char: I'm still afraid. That won't make me stop.
TANX.talk.SATORI.0-0.ancient: You bring the scent of the underworld—and an unfinished question.
TANX.talk.SATORI.0-1.char: Has a girl in a green hat passed through here? She always appears when no one's looking.
TANX.talk.SATORI.0-2.ancient: No voice doesn't mean no one passed by. The wind doesn't explain itself, either.
TANX.talk.SATORI.0-3.char: Then tell me where the wind went.
TANX.talk.SATORI.1-1.char: Watching, too. Koishi likes to slip through places others overlook.
TANX.talk.SATORI.2-1r.char: That's all right. The Palace of the Earth Spirits will leave a light on for us.
TEZCATARA.talk.SATORI.0-0.ancient: Come, warm your hands first. You look like you haven't rested in a long while.
TEZCATARA.talk.SATORI.0-1.char: I'm looking for my sister, Koishi Komeiji. Have you heard anything about her?
TEZCATARA.talk.SATORI.0-2.ancient: I haven't. But don't lose yourself while searching for someone else. Take this gift.
TEZCATARA.talk.SATORI.0-3.char: Thank you. When I find her, I'd like to bring her to meet you.
TEZCATARA.talk.SATORI.1-0.ancient: Would you like to stay a little longer today?
TEZCATARA.talk.SATORI.1-1.char: Just a little. I still have the house key. I want to go home with Koishi.
TEZCATARA.talk.SATORI.2-0r.ancient: Your sister must have people who miss her.
TEZCATARA.talk.SATORI.2-1r.char: Yes. Not just me—Orin, Okuu, and everyone at the Palace of the Earth Spirits, too.
VAKUU.talk.SATORI.0-0.ancient: You can hear nightmares. Why walk into one?
VAKUU.talk.SATORI.0-1.char: Someone's memories are here. They may hide where Koishi went.
VAKUU.talk.SATORI.0-2.ancient: You're not afraid you won't find her. You're afraid she won't need you.
VAKUU.talk.SATORI.0-3.char: Even so, she should know I'm looking for her.
VAKUU.talk.SATORI.1-0.ancient: Those voices are still telling you to stop.
VAKUU.talk.SATORI.1-1.char: That's my fear, not Koishi's answer.
VAKUU.talk.SATORI.2-0r.ancient: Your eye cannot open every door.
VAKUU.talk.SATORI.2-1r.char: I know. I can knock, too.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SATORI.0-0.char: Your Tower remembers every intruder. Tell me: where is Koishi Komeiji?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SATORI.0-1.ancient: You think understanding memories gives you every way out?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SATORI.0-2.char: She walks beyond awareness, her Third Eye closed. I won't leave her trapped in your cycle.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SATORI.1-0.char: I read the same Tower again. Still, I hear no voice from her.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SATORI.1-1.ancient: You can reshape this victory. Or accept that she isn't yours to arrange.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SATORI.1-2.char: I won't arrange her life. I only ask that this Tower not close its doors for her.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SATORI.2-0r.ancient: Will you repeat this search again?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SATORI.2-1r.char: As long as there's a path. I'll find my sister and ask where she wants to go.
FALLBACK.talk.SATORI.0-0.char: I'm looking for a girl in a green hat: Koishi Komeiji. Her thoughts are quiet.
FALLBACK.talk.SATORI.0-1.ancient: Even quiet people leave traces. Take this strength and keep going.
FALLBACK.talk.SATORI.1-0.ancient: Are you still looking for her?
FALLBACK.talk.SATORI.1-1.char: Yes. I'll see the traces she leaves behind.
FALLBACK.talk.SATORI.2-0r.ancient: What do you want this time?
FALLBACK.talk.SATORI.2-1r.char: A clue to my sister—and the strength to keep going.
